profile.ja: 吸血鬼狩りを得意とする陰陽師。対魔忍・神村舞華の姉。陰陽師を養成する組織・五行学園で教師を務める。常にくわえタバコのヤンキー先生。彼女の吸うタバコは特製の陰陽たばこで、周囲に魔が接近するとすぐに紫煙が反応する。特に吸血鬼に対しては弱体化効果もある。得物は“超絶鬼切”。神村家に代々伝わる神器“鬼切”をベースに作られた特殊武器であり、千の魔物に合わせて千の変化をするという超科学陰陽決戦兵器である。
profile.en: She is an onmyoji who specializes in hunting vampires. She is the older sister of Taimanin Kamimura Maika. She serves as a teacher at the Gogyō Academy, an organization that trains onmyoji. She's a yankī-style teacher who always has a cigarette in her mouth. The tobacco she smokes is a special onmyoji blend that instantly reacts with purple smoke when demonic presence approaches. It especially weakens vampires. Her weapon is the "Super-Ultimate Oni-Kiri," a special weapon based on the family heirloom "Oni-Kiri" that can change a thousand ways to match a thousand monsters—a hyper-scientific onmyoji battle weapon.
